# Sleeve accounting, curated and deduplicated (2026-10-29)

## SCOPE (InfinityBlade)

- Surface: one entry per real strategy, deduplicated across every desk roster in the crosswalk; arranged by TYPE, then family, then name.
- Constraints: a merge without evidence is a fabrication. Merges use evidence tiers A (documented grouping), B (exact id equality, implicit: the same id string is one alias), C (mechanical identity: desk naming differences only, with family/style/description corroboration). No Tier D judgment merges were needed beyond C; doubtful singletons stay separate and are flagged UNRESOLVED. Algorithm text is assembled only from recorded sources (Test catalog entry/variant fields, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, lz_engine entry/exit/sizing configs, ausar_map params/variant text, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slices, femto land-wt config params). Where a source records only part of an algorithm the entry is marked PARTIAL and the gap is named. Nothing was invented.
- Outcome: every raw id appears exactly once, as an alias of one strategy or in the closing non-strategy section.
- Proof: counts below are computed from accounting.json after writing; alias total reconciles exactly to the crosswalk universe.

## Counts (reconciled in print)

- Raw sleeve ids in the crosswalk universe: **1562** (1,560 authoritative ids + the 2 named census artifacts `bars` and `id`, which sit in the non-strategy section).
- Strategies: **651**
- Aliases across strategies: **1559**
- Non-strategy (monitor/recorder/artifact) ids, counted separately: **3**
- Check: 1559 + 3 = **1562** = raw ids. Exact.
- Merges by tier: A documented grouping: 752 union operations; C mechanical identity: 156; B exact-id is structural (one node per id string); D curated judgment: 0 (none asserted without A/C-grade evidence).
- UNRESOLVED entries (kept separate, never force-merged): **104** (listed in MERGES.md with what would settle each class).
- Algorithm completeness: FULL **224**, PARTIAL **427** (each PARTIAL entry names its specific gap).

- Signal / entry rules:
  - [R19_ETF_CORE25_M150] ausar variant: QQQ core with a momentum tilt · 150% exposure
  - [ausar_pb84] Ranks the configured ETF basket by its completed 126-session price return; equal scores use alphabetical ticker order. - Trades: QQQ shares, long and short — QQQ
- Timeframe: 10m
- Created by / source: Milkman Trades' PO10 extreme algo (NQ, August 2026 thread), translated to QQQ shares
- Description (from source records): PO10 - QQQ 10-minute momentum
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, ausar_map params/variant, femto land-wt config params, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slice

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_pb10] Build 10-minute readings from QQQ 5-minute bars. Enter on a completed reading above +100 for QQQ or below -100 for QID. Entries are allowed 09:30-11:00 ET, once per session, with no re-entry after an exit.
  - [po10_qqq] sleeve-owned (sleeves/po10_qqq.py)
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb10] Close on the opposite completed 10-minute cross; sell any remaining shares at 15:59 ET. The strategy has no fixed-price stop or target.
  - [po10_qqq] sleeve-owned exit intents
- Sizing:
  - [po10_qqq] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 125000.0, "cash_usd": 125000.0} parked=False
- Filters / data:
  - [ausar_pb10] data: QQQ 5-minute SIP bars from the configured extended-hours feed, completed 10-minute oscillator readings, QQQ and QID share quotes, and the New York session clock.
  - [po10_qqq] data: WARMUP_BARS={"5Min": 600}

### Variants (1)
- **base form (variant zero)**: base strategy as documented; no distinct variant recorded
  - aliases: ausar_pb10, muse_po10_qqq, po10_qqq

### Aliases (3) and status history
- `ausar_pb10` — md2_catalog: merged; md2_ausar_map: present in roster
- `muse_po10_qqq` — test_catalog: entry muse-po10-qqq status_counts={'waiting': 1}
- `po10_qqq` — test_catalog: entry muse-po10-qqq status_counts={'waiting': 1}; muse_desk_v3: active roster; md2_catalog: installed; femto_land_wt: present in roster; femto_land_wt: present in roster; md2_silicon_v2: present in roster

  - [ausar_pb46] On completed hourly bars within the configured UTC date window, enter long when Wilder RSI2 < 10, close > SMA200 and SMA4(RSI2) < 30. Exit when close > SMA5, the average of the five most recent hourly closes. The configured stop is disabled; no short entry is permitted.

## 15.87 Rule (SPY 0DTE)

- Type: options directional | Family: muse | Style evidence (catalog): Expected-move levels
- Trades: SPY options (0DTE) — SPY (QQQ confirms)
- Timeframe: 5m
- Created by / source: Azrael's 15.87 Rule, reverse-engineered from his worksheet
- Description (from source records): 15.87 Rule - SPY same-day options
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, ausar_map params/variant, femto land-wt config params, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slice

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_pb9] Expected move in SPY points = prior SPY close × (prior VIX close ÷ 15.87 ÷ 100), rounded to 0.1. Map walls at ±1 expected move, shelves at ±0.5, and prior close as the magnet. Below VIX 15, fade the edges. From 15 to 18.5, trade only a same-bar SPY/QQQ break beyond their first-20-minute ranges. Above 18.5, do not fade and halve size. Enter 09:50-11:05 ET; one setup per session.
  - [em_1587] sleeve-owned (sleeves/em_1587.py)
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb9] Break: target the next mapped level; invalidate on a 5-minute close back inside the opening range. Fade: target prior SPY close; exit on a 5-minute close half an expected move beyond the wall. Flat 11:30 ET.
  - [em_1587] sleeve-owned exit intents
- Sizing:
  - [em_1587] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
- Filters / data:
  - [ausar_pb9] data: Prior VIX and SPY closes, completed SPY and QQQ 5-minute opening ranges, mapped SPY levels, option-chain metadata and open-interest snapshot, and the session clock.
  - [em_1587] data: WARMUP_BARS={"5Min": 78}

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_pb11] The prior SPY close is the anchor. Golden Gate levels sit 38.2% of ATR(14) above and below it. The completed 1-hour Phase Oscillator and 10-minute trend ribbon must permit an entry. A breakout also needs QQQ to move in the same direction. A Trigger Box entry needs a completed 3-minute close through the 23.6% level. When the session is classified as a range, the strategy fades a 38.2% level toward 
  - [saty_day] sleeve-owned (sleeves/saty_day.py)
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb11] Golden Gate: an adverse 10-minute close through 23.6% invalidates; take half at 50%, the rest at 61.8%, and qualified runners at 78.6% or 1 ATR. Trigger Box: exit on a 3-minute close back through entry. Range trades exit on range break. Flat 15:55 ET.
  - [saty_day] sleeve-owned exit intents

  - [saty_day] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False

- Type: options directional | Family: muse | Style evidence (catalog): Intraday ATR levels

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_pb12] Golden Gate: take the first 38.2% level crossing in either direction when the session opens inside the level. Trigger: take the first 3-minute close above +23.6% when the session opens inside ±23.6%; this trigger is bullish only. The completed 1-hour Phase Oscillator is recorded but does not gate entry. Enter 09:35–14:30 ET and at least 90 minutes before the actual close.
  - [ausar_pb13] Golden Gate: take the first 38.2% level crossing in either direction when the session opens inside the level. Trigger: take the first 3-minute close above +23.6% when the session opens inside ±23.6%; this trigger is bullish only. The completed 1-hour Phase Oscillator is recorded but does not gate entry. Enter 09:35–14:30 ET and at least 90 minutes before the actual close.
  - [saty_sol] sleeve-owned (sleeves/saty_sol.py)
  - [saty_sol_0dte] sleeve-owned (sleeves/saty_sol_0dte.py)
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb12] Golden Gate: exit all at 61.8% or on a post-fill 10-minute close through adverse 23.6%. Trigger: exit at 38.2% or on a post-fill 3-minute close through adverse 23.6%. No partials. Flatten 10 minutes before close and never carry through expiry.
  - [ausar_pb13] Golden Gate: exit all at 61.8% or on a post-fill 10-minute close through the adverse 23.6% level. Trigger: exit at 38.2% or on a post-fill 3-minute close through adverse 23.6%. No partials. Flatten 10 minutes before close; the 1% daily-loss halt blocks entries, not exits.
  - [saty_sol] sleeve-owned exit intents
  - [saty_sol_0dte] sleeve-owned exit intents
- Sizing:
  - [saty_sol] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
  - [saty_sol_0dte] v3 slice: {"capital_usd": 10000.0, "cash_usd": 10000.0} parked=False
- Filters / data:
  - [ausar_pb12] data: Frozen prior SPY close and ATR(14), completed daily, 1-hour, 10-minute and 3-minute bars, current SPY price, same-day SPY options and fresh quotes, and the actual session close.
  - [ausar_pb13] data: Frozen prior SPY close and ATR(14), completed daily, 1-hour, 10-minute and 3-minute bars, current SPY price, listed SPY options and fresh quotes, and the actual session close.
  - [saty_sol] data: WARMUP_BARS={"5Min": 300, "1Min": 390}

- Trades: US ETFs — QQQ, SPY, SMH, XLB, XLC, XLE, XLF, XLI, XLK, XLP, XLRE, XLU, XLV, XLY; QLD for the 2x controls
- Timeframe: 1d, monthly rebalance
- Created by / source: Ausar R17/R18 ETF research, frozen as the R19 ETF books
- Description (from source records): R19 ETF books: momentum leader rotation
- Algorithm status: **FULL**
- Algorithm sources consulted: Test catalog entry/variants, ausar_map params/variant, femto land-wt config params, md2 catalog entry/exit/strategy text, muse-desk-v3 roster params/slice

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [R19_ETF_LEADER1_C098] ausar variant: ETF momentum leader · 98% exposure
  - [R19_ETF_LEADER1_M150] ausar variant: ETF momentum leader · 150% exposure
  - [ausar_pb95] Ranks the configured ETF basket by its completed 126-session price return; equal scores use alphabetical ticker order. Allocates to the selected fund. Targets ETF holdings worth 98% of the paper account's net value, rounded down to whole shares.
  - [ausar_pb96] Ranks the configured ETF basket by its completed 126-session price return; equal scores use alphabetical ticker order. Allocates to the selected fund. Targets ETF holdings worth 150% of the paper account's net value, rounded down to whole shares. The excess uses simulated borrowing.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_LEADER1_C098] Ranks the configured ETF basket by its completed 126-session price return; equal scores use alphabetical ticker order. Allocates to the selected fund. Targets ETF holdings worth 98% of the paper account's net value, rounded down to whole shares.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_LEADER1_M150] Ranks the configured ETF basket by its completed 126-session price return; equal scores use alphabetical ticker order. Allocates to the selected fund. Targets ETF holdings worth 150% of the paper account's net value, rounded down to whole shares. The excess uses simulated borrowing.
  - [free_etf] sleeve-owned (sleeves/free_etf.py)
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb95] Reduce or replace holdings when the next monthly selection changes their target. This strategy has no price-based stop or profit target.
  - [ausar_pb96] Reduce or replace holdings when the next monthly selection changes their target. This strategy has no price-based stop or profit target.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_LEADER1_C098] Reduce or replace holdings when the next monthly selection changes their target. This strategy has no price-based stop or profit target.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_LEADER1_M150] Reduce or replace holdings when the next monthly selection changes their target. This strategy has no price-based stop or profit target.

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [R19_ETF_INTERVAL1_M150] ausar variant: ETF leader confirmed across two sources · 150% exposure
  - [ausar_pb90] Calculates each ETF’s completed 126-session return separately from Alpaca and Yahoo. The two values form a range. A new leader is chosen only when its lower return exceeds every competitor’s higher return. When ranges overlap, retain the incumbent if it is still a possible winner; otherwise select QQQ. Allocates to the selected fund. Targets ETF holdings worth 150% of the paper account's net value
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_INTERVAL1_M150] Calculates each ETF’s completed 126-session return separately from Alpaca and Yahoo. The two values form a range. A new leader is chosen only when its lower return exceeds every competitor’s higher return. When ranges overlap, retain the incumbent if it is still a possible winner; otherwise select QQQ. Allocates to the selected fund. Targets ETF holdings worth 150% of the paper account's net value
- Exit rules:
  - [ausar_pb90] Reduce or replace holdings when the next monthly selection changes their target. This strategy has no price-based stop or profit target.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_INTERVAL1_M150] Reduce or replace holdings when the next monthly selection changes their target. This strategy has no price-based stop or profit target.
- Sizing:
  - not recorded in any consulted source
- Filters / data:
  - [ausar_pb90] data: Completed historical ETF bars for signals; separately labeled IEX quotes for execution. The two-source versions compare complete Alpaca and Yahoo histories without joining them.
  - [ausar_r19_R19_ETF_INTERVAL1_M150] data: posted r19 data adapters
- Key parameters (recorded, per alias): {"R19_ETF_INTERVAL1_M150": {"symbols": ["QQQ", "SPY", "SMH", "XLB", "XLC", "XLE", "XLF", "XLI", "XLK", "XLP", "XLRE", "XLU", "XLV", "XLY"]}}

### Detailed algorithm
- Signal / entry rules:
  - [ausar_pb3] A four-completed-bar panel must show Tensor balance improving by at least two, with at least two of seven component votes increasing. - Exit rules:
